top_signals.title: A Guide to Wall Street’s Hot Debates, From Carry Trades to Treasury Twists
top_signals.summary: Investors haven’t been able to enjoy a summer lull as Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent have kept them busy with a series of eye-catching policy decisions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Slip Before Warsh, Bonds Steady: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stock-index futures slipped and Treasuries steadied as traders avoided big bets before Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech, looking for clues on the path of interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Venezuela Considers Leaving OPEC in Blow to Oil Cartel
top_signals.summary: Venezuela is considering whether it should quit OPEC, potentially delivering a fresh blow to the oil cartel it helped create. Bloomberg's Stephen Stapczynski discusses what it means. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
